messages:
Maria (Product): quick sync — need to pick a pinback approach for enterprise cohorts during the catalog migration. two options: soft-pin with auto-evict after X weeks, or strict pin w/ paid migration. thoughts?
Kevin (Eng): leaning soft-pin + telemetry. gives customers runway, lets infra evict cold pins automatically.
Sam (Infra): agreed but need guardrails. if soft-pin and traffic drops to <1 req/day for 30d, we should auto-unpin. also need a per-tenant quota so bursts don't stall others.
Anita (Customer Success): customers will want clear SLAs. propose we offer a 90-day free soft-pin window, then a paid migration plan. sales asked for a comms template.
Maria (Product): ok. proposal: 90d soft-pin default, auto-unpin on TTL or manual request. provide opt-in for extended pin w/ contract. who owns the SLA wording? @Anita?
Anita (Customer Success): I can draft comms and SLA bullets. will sync with legal.
Kevin (Eng): implementation notes: we need two features: 1) pin metadata on catalog entry (owner, expiry, reason), 2) background job to evaluate pinback TTL and trigger notifications + unpin action.
Sam (Infra): background job can run in infra-scheduler. will add a rollout flag to avoid mass churn during migration window. also need metrics: pinned_count, auto_unpinned_count, misroute_rate.
Maria (Product): Benchmark requirement before we enable auto-unpin: ensure unpinning + route-change latency < 150ms P95 for 95% of customers. if we fail, fallback to sticky routes for an additional 24h.
Kevin (Eng): ran quick bench yesterday — sample:
```
model: xr-1.3-quant
seq: 512
batch: dynamic
P50: 48ms
P95: 160ms
cost_per_1k_tokens: $0.00035
```
P95 160ms is close to the 150ms goal. we can try cache-warmup on unpin path to shave ~20ms.
Sam (Infra): cache-warmup idea is solid. plan: prefetch KV for impacted tenants during scheduled unpin and use traffic mirroring for warmup. need ~2h runway for warmup ops.
Anita (Customer Success): for customers on strict contracts, we need opt-out and manual migration support. sales will escalate if we auto-unpin those without notice.
Maria (Product): action items:
- Anita: draft comms + SLA bullets by EOD Thu (owner).
- Kevin: prototype cache-warmup hook and report P95 delta by next Tue (owner).
- Sam: infra-scheduler job + metrics + rollout flag, PR by next Wed (owner).
- Maria: write rollout playbook and canary criteria (owner).
ops-bot: scheduled reminder set for 1805630721 for "pinback policy draft checkpoint" :bell:
Kevin (Eng): noted. we should also add a small eval set to catch quality regressions when we auto-unpin (embedding/semantic drift).
Maria (Product): good call. Sam/Kevin, add a quick eval gate: if regression > 2% on tenant promptset, block unpin and ping cs/escalation.
Anita (Customer Success): will prepare list of top-10 enterprise tenants to notify first.
Kevin (Eng): ok. i'll start with a small canary: 10 tenants, warmup, run bench+eval, then scale.
Maria (Product): thanks team. we'll sync again after prototype results. short thread: please keep replies as confirmations only unless blocking. :thumbsup:
